summary_1line: Dushmanta persuades Sakuntala to a Gandharva marriage, agrees their son will be heir, and Kanwa later approves the secret union, foretelling a mighty son.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the forest hermitage, King Dushmanta earnestly proposes to Sakuntala while she stands beneath trees, hesitant yet listening.
Sakuntala, modest yet firm, sets the condition that her future son must become the king’s heir as they stand in the quiet hermitage clearing.
The sage Kanwa, returning to the hermitage, gazes calmly at the shy Sakuntala and reveals he already knows of her secret union through spiritual insight.
